base: Edit this botanical silhouette. Preserve the flower species, the recognizable blossom contour, the single warm ivory silhouette color, and the refined organic paper-cut style of the reference. Change its COMPOSITION and STEMS so it reads as a plant growing diagonally from outside a round garden window into its opening. IMPORTANT: do NOT draw a window, circle, frame, wall, scenery, shadows, text, labels or background; the app draws the window separately behind this plant. Use a truly transparent background. Imaginary composition guide: square canvas; imaginary window centered at (50%,50%) with radius 36% of canvas. The long visible branch enters from the OUTSIDE LOWER LEFT, with its pointed cut-off root at approximately (9%,86%). It sweeps diagonally up and right to a blossom near (68%,30%). The main blossom occupies about 34% of the canvas width. A small leaf or secondary branch near (26%,63%) crosses the imaginary window's lower-left rim and remains in the foreground. Some of the plant must visibly lie OUTSIDE the imaginary circle, with the stem crossing its lower-left rim. The cut-off root must be the lowest LEFTMOST endpoint, never under the center of the flower. Keep empty space in the upper left of the imaginary window. Avoid a self-contained upright potted-plant silhouette, a stem ending at bottom center, a circled logo composition, mirrored symmetry, extra decorative details, textures, gradients, outlines and stray speckles. Broad clean negative gaps and gently tapering stem, readable at 52 pixels. The whole plant must fit within the square canvas margins. Specific subject notes:
